title: WWBN AVideo 29.1.0 through 29.7.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to…
description: WWBN AVideo versions 29.1.0 through 29.7.1 have a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the channel About field. Registered users can inject malicious markup that bypasses filtering and executes when the channel feed is viewed, potentially affecting any visitor including administrators.
